limits: All commands use deadlines below two minutes. Timed-out captures remain partial evidence.

CPU comparison uses the completed native control and an independently recorded oracle for identical source files and rule IDs; the original oracle-filtering mismatch is reconciled without changing the native report.
The restricted state source adapter retains generated-file freshness as an upstream integration observation.
Heap sizes are ownership estimates; they are not RSS and can overlap other retained categories.
Two full Rust unit-binary builds exceeded the deadline; the memory invariant is instead exercised through the public binding, edits, removal, and close.
The diagnostic binding has no cross-crate LTO; its timings are not compared as a speedup over the reference binding.
No new full-repository performance baseline is claimed.
